families.controls: Every roster expiry/created timestamp uses canonical real-calendar parsing within the existing String wire shape; staged ACK expiry must be a real instant exactly equal to the reviewed expiry before execution.

families.controls: Exact interoperable integers; decimal text is bounded before conversion; immutable opaque identifiers; actual zoned calendar instants and UTC year bounds.
families.why: Native and JavaScript must agree on financial values. Normalizing impossible dates or assigning device timezones to naive timestamps changes evidence.

families.controls: Profile/group IDs and optional owner semantics; suggested amounts; group summaries; notification identity/date fields; roster disclosure and health count contracts.
families.why: Forged IDs, truncated suggestions, unsafe counts and missing metadata must be rejected before they can become authorized client state.

families.controls: Positive exact RWF amounts and coherent aliases; explicit route/currency; no invented pending status; chronological intent lifetime; posting/payment identity precedence retained where fields describe distinct schemas.
families.why: Alias conflicts must not select whichever amount is convenient. Historical expired intents remain valid history, while malformed lifetimes and unsupported payment routes cannot become actionable.

families.controls: Unique IDs; exact count and full aggregates; loaded sums cannot exceed aggregates; coherent own IDs/flags; full-page equality; immutable cursor/revision/request/order checks.
families.why: A recent window cannot prove a complete total or supported-group count. A forged own flag or repeated cursor must not inflate displayed financial totals.

families.controls: Present array/map structure validated before legacy filters; all window IDs unique; missing aggregates/counts stay unknown; explicit zero preserved; real saved date; optional absent public owner round trips as null; damaged summary isolated.
families.why: Invalid cached rows must not disappear into a misleading empty or zero result. Legacy migration must preserve valid Rwanda data without reviving foreign financial totals.

families.controls: Actual SDK profile/group/summary/event identity validation and duplicate checks; requested intent/group match; exact counts; captured Bearer and sticky session checks after every initial-read await; old session cannot dispatch later stages.
families.why: Blocking only final publication still allowed a retained old pipeline to make later calls under replacement authority. The prior immutable probe reproduced all ten replacement-stage cases and mixed token headers during a valid refresh.

families.controls: Create group/profile update/group profile/join/promote/archive/transfer/notification pipelines retain immutable session authority; RPC and scoped fetch Bearer pinned; returned identity validated; capability timestamp strict; late native/verdict/reply cannot publish or advance old workflow.
families.why: The same user ID after a new session, or A to B to A, is not permission to complete a departed operation. Returned profile, owner and membership fields must match the submitted operation.

families.controls: Repository replacement/session revision/profile/sync invalidates history, roster and health; late resolved and in-flight values are fenced; aggregate providers retain unknown; local complete-history shortcut is explicit fixture-only.
families.why: Resolved provider values and retained controllers otherwise outlive the session that authorized them. Offline partial windows cannot establish a complete production total.

families.controls: Decimal digits bounded before parsing; leading zeros and composing edits preserved; positive safe amount before native channel; preflight intent identity/amount/receiver/instant exact.
families.why: JavaScript integer conversion can change large pasted input before validation. A contribution must launch only the exact reviewed current request.

families.controls: Real zoned captured instant, TTL, exact record/generation/owner/slug; local DateTime retains its instant when serialized UTC.
families.why: An impossible calendar value previously normalized into a still-valid invitation retention window. The store must never silently extend or reinterpret an invitation.

families.controls: Exact bounded money flows from validated DTOs; formatting preserves maximum positive/negative digits in default/en/fr/rw on VM and Chrome; display dates use the instant converted to local time.
families.why: Correct wire values are insufficient if a formatter rounds them. Date rendering must use a real instant; local display conversion is source reviewed, not a claim of every physical-device timezone configuration.

families.controls: Absent summary/page stays unavailable; known zero remains zero; supported groups cannot become a complete empty set from a partial window; fresh roster loading/error removes retained IDs/amounts; all rows display validated DTO amounts/dates.
families.why: A zero or no-activity message is a financial assertion. It requires explicit complete metadata. Retained AsyncData during authorization refresh is not current roster authority.

families.controls: Sticky repository/session/profile captured across preparation, profile gate, preflight and native launch; stale reply/error cannot update the flow; provider subscription survives transient missing-group state.
families.why: A departed session cannot authorize a payment later in the same mounted widget. Losing the subscription during Auth clearance also prevented a legitimate current session from recovering.

families.controls: Source-reviewed hosts call corrected repository operations; they do not decode financial JSON or derive financial totals. Their repository data/authority boundaries are directly tested; these tests do not certify every host navigation/visual state.
families.why: A source callsite and a repository proof are distinct evidence. Keep the exact lower-layer acceptance without claiming an unrun complete widget journey.

families.controls: Invitation operations and save-result proof owned by asset worker; summary display source-reviewed unknown guard; exact current acceptance supplied separately.
families.why: Invitation permission/session and external save-result semantics need their own accepted packet; the shared data gate must not infer them from compilation.

families.controls: Canonical timestamp reused by runtime receipts; preference revision/session and remote push owner/session/UUID/deep-link/minimal payload controls inspected; durable SMS receipt is storage identity/hash ACK, not settlement.
families.why: Push payloads and receipts cannot become payment or ownership evidence. These dedicated behavior cohorts belong to root/current platform packets and are not executed by this data gate.

families.controls: Native observation snapshot requires explicit Boolean fields and integer counts in 0..100; missing or malformed status cannot become zero. Enrollment/reason are allowlisted; UI distinguishes callbacks from actual recipient delivery.
families.why: Gateway callback counts are bounded operational observations, not financial settlement or handset delivery proof. Runtime compilation and dedicated native acceptance remain owned by root.

families.controls: Captured genuine public reconciliation SQL mechanics feed the production history/balance decoders in VM and real Chrome; every window, continuation, complete exact sum, ownership flag, real timestamp and zero/unknown count is checked.
families.why: Independent fake JSON model cases cannot prove that actual server receipts are compatible. The same source-bound SQL JSON must preserve precision and semantics in both native Dart and JavaScript. Synthetic mechanical fixtures and any server failures remain separately labeled.

families.controls: Unique topic per authority scope; existing sticky session captured before subscribing and required by callbacks; current refresh and cache reconciliation supported.
families.why: The actual locked SDK routed departed static-topic frames into replacement callbacks after same-user replacement, A to B to A and account replacement. A user ID alone did not identify the active subscription authority.
